title: Death Note Quiz
description: Nine questions on the people, the studio and the songs behind the Death Note anime and manga.

questions.question: Who drew the Death Note manga?
questions.fun_fact: Tsugumi Ohba wrote the story and Takeshi Obata drew the manga.

questions.question: Which magazine first serialized the Death Note manga?
questions.fun_fact: The magazine is published by Shueisha.

questions.question: Which studio animated the Death Note TV series?
questions.fun_fact: The anime was produced by the studio Madhouse.

questions.question: How many episodes does the Death Note anime have?
Who directed the Death Note anime?
Which band performed the first opening of the Death Note anime?
questions.fun_fact: The first opening is the WORLD by Nightmare.

questions.question: Which song is the second ending of the Death Note anime?
questions.fun_fact: The second ending is Zetsubou Billy by Maximum the Hormone.

questions.question: What kind of supernatural being is Ryuk?
questions.fun_fact: Ryuk is a death god who drops his notebook into the human world.

questions.question: Which food does Ryuk crave in the human world?
questions.fun_fact: Ryuk loves apples, the one human food he cannot resist.
